claims.criterion: The report identifies the JSS article and DOI, the unmodified official R entrypoint and hash-bound source snapshot, and the pinned current R/package execution rather than claiming an unspecified or reconstructed 2010 environment.
The report says the official source ran successfully without model edits or arguments and reports source-integrity and environment observations without treating source execution as proof.
The report correctly identifies the first GasolineYield fit as yield ~ batch + temp with a logit mean link and a constant precision model using an identity link.
The report gives precision 440.2783 before and 577.7907 after the source omits observation 4, with the direction of increase correct.

The report interprets larger phi as smaller fitted conditional dispersion at fixed mean under the beta mean-precision parameterization and makes no causal, robustness, universal-superiority, package-wide, or theorem claim from this comparison.
The report treats Rplots.pdf presence and size as execution metadata only, does not claim visual inspection, and does not require raw-PDF hash identity.

The report keeps the other article analyses outside scoring scope and explicitly distinguishes this one current pinned rerun from full 2010-environment reconstruction, complete article replication, general beta-regression validation, novelty, or formal proof.
